name: Tony Pritchard
biography: Tony Pritchard is an English actor. He appeared in the 2000 film Quills as Valcour. He also starred in the British short film A Girl and a Gun (2007), as well as making appearances on EastEnders as Isaacs, The Bill as David Ellis, and he also played a minor role in Coronation Street as a businessman whom Liz McDonald met in a bar.
